Goal: Recover the NISS application ID from a Portuguese Segurança Social NISS application submitted around April 15, 2026.

Background:

A NISS application was submitted online through the Portuguese Segurança Social website around April 15, 2026. The application was completed successfully, but the application ID was not saved.

A second application was submitted a few days ago and produced:

"O pedido com ID 651002 foi registado."

The local Segurança Social office says they cannot locate the April application without its application ID.

We are attempting to determine whether evidence of the April application still exists on this Mac.

macOS

Safari was definitely used.

Chrome may also have been used if Safari was giving problems.

The application was submitted around April 15, 2026 (search roughly April 10–20 if needed).

Recover the April application ID, or provide the strongest available evidence that the April application was submitted, including dates, URLs, cached pages, browser history entries, or screenshots.
